name: scramble-in
title: Scramble In
description: Text types itself in left to right with a short run of random glyphs ahead of the cursor that resolve into the real letters; several lines can start in a quick cascade.
useWhen: A list, tracklist or block of text should decode onto the screen line by line with a hacker-style run of random glyphs.
You want a fixed-width layout that never reflows while the text appears.
avoidWhen: Each word should scramble and lock in on its own: use scramble-reveal or caption-scramble.
The text should type with a caret: use typewriter.
author: Daniel Petho
